crossRefs.note: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.
Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

parallels.note: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…

translations.web: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
translations.bsb: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
translations.asv: And thou shalt take no bribe: for a bribe blindeth them that have sight, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
